claims.text: List comprehensions provide a concise way to create new lists by applying an expression across an iterable, optionally with filtering conditions.
A list comprehension uses an expression followed by a for clause and can include additional for or if clauses.
Comprehensions compute container items using looping and filtering instructions rather than listing every item explicitly.
Dictionary comprehensions can construct dictionaries from key and value expressions evaluated over an iterable.
A dictionary comprehension starts with a key-value pair followed by comprehension clauses, producing key-value entries in the new dictionary.

goal: Use Python list and dictionary comprehensions to transform and filter data.
